chapter.verse: Tembaw tawh Italy gam ka pai ding vai uh a kikhensat khit ciangin amaute in Augustus Galkap Thuangpi pan Julius minnei za-uk bupa' tungah Paul leh thongkia dang kimkhat ap uh hi.

Adramyttium khua pan Asia gam tuipikil dunga om tembaw khawlna khuate ah a pai dinga kithawi tembaw khat ah ka tuang uh a, tuipi khualzin ka kipan uh hi. Thessalonica khuami Macedonia minam Aristarchus in ko hong zui hi.
A zingciangin Sidon khua ka tung uh hi. Julius in Paul itbawl a, Paul a lawmte in a huh a van theih nadingin amaute' kiangah paisak hi.
Tua lai pan ka dinkhiat uh ciangin huihnun lem lo ahih manin Cyprus tuikulh pang beelin ka pai uh hi.
Cilicia leh Pamphylia tuipikil dung tawh a kigalsai tuipi laizang ka kantan khit uh ciangin Lycia gam Myra khua ka tung uh hi.
Tua takah za-uk bupa in Italy pai ding Alexandria tembaw khat a muh ciangin ko teng hong tuangsak hi.
Ni tampi sung damtak ka pai uh a, haksapi-in Cnidus tuikulh tawh kigalsai mun ka tun laitakun huihnun in hong khaktan ahih manin Salmone khua galkhat, Crete tuikulh pang huihliahna mun ka tawn uh hi.
Tuipikil dung haksapi-in ka zui uh a, Lasea khua tawh kinai Khawlmun Nuam cihna ahi Kalous Limenas ka tung uh hi.
Hun saupi bei khinin Antan Hun nangawn kheng khinta a, tuilam khualzinna lauhuai ta ahih manin Paul in amaute' kiangah,
“Lawmte aw, tuilam khualzinna ah van leh tembaw bek hilo-in eima' nuntakna mahmah zong liamna baina leh supna tampi om ding cih ka phawkkha hi,” ci-in phawnna pia hi.
Ahih hangin za-uk bupa in Paul' thugen sangin tembaw hawlpipa leh tembaw nei mihaupa' thugen thusimzaw hi.

Tu-a khawlmun pen phalbi sung om nading hoih zolo ahih manin Crete tuikulh tembaw khawlna khua khat ahi, nitum-leitawlam leh nitum-leilulam leikiu mun nih a maingat, Phoenix khua kitung zo hileh tua takah phalbi sung ki-om thei ding cih lametna tawh mi a tamzawte in tua mun pan tuilam khualzin zop dingin khensat uh hi.
Leitawlam pan huihdam hong nun ciangin a geelna uh tangtut ding cih ngaihsutna tawh amaute in tembaw sikkawikip dokkhia-in Crete tuikulh dung, tuinawl piau tawh a kinai-in pai uh hi.
Ahih hangin a sawt lo-in nisuah-leilulam huih a kici huihpi khauh mahmah khat tuikulh lam pan hong nung hi.
Tembaw zong huihpi a tuah ciangin phu zolo a, cih nading om lo-in huih' mutna peuh ka kikawihei lel uh hi.
Cauda a kici tuikulhno khat ii pang, huihnun a phatdopna mun ah ka kikawihei laitakun tembaw nungpanga kikhih gunkuang haksapi-in ka hu zo uh hi.

Tua a kaihtoh khit uh ciangin tembaw nasemte in nanna kamna vante tawh tembaw gak uh hi. Tua ciangin tui daina mun Syrtis tuipigeek ah awkkhak ding lau uh ahih manin nungkaih bung damtak khiasuk uh a, tua panin tuihual zui-in tembaw kihei kawikawi hi.
Huihpi tuihual nasia thuak lua ka hih manun a zingciangin tembaw nasemte in van teng tembaw tungpan lotkhiat kipan uh hi.
Ni thumni ciangin tembaw vanzatte amau' khut mah tawh tembaw tungpan lawnkhia uh hi.
Ni tampi sung ni ahi-a aksi ahi zongin kimu lo-in khua kipei khauh mahmah ahih manin a tawpna ah hong kihonkhia dinga ka lametna khempeuh uh beimang ta hi.

Mite an a ngolh uh sauvei ta ahih manin amaute' lakah Paul dingto a, “Lawmte aw, ka thugen hong mang hileh uhcin-a Crete tuikulh pan a dingkhia lo hi lehang hih siatna leh supna tawh i kipelh ding hi.
Tu-in zong lungnuamin na om ding uh kong hanthawn hi. Note mihing a si a mang na om kei ding uh a, tembaw bek kisia ding hi.
A hang pen kei hong nei-in ke'n zong a na ka sep Pasian, a vanmi khat tu zanin ka mai-ah hong ding a,
‘Paul aw, lau kei in. Caesar' mai-ah na ding hamtang ding hi. En in, Pasian in tembaw na tuanpih khempeuh a suahtak nading hehpihna nang hong ap khinzo hi,’ hong ci hi.
Tua ahih manin lawmte aw, lungnuamin om un. A hang pen kei' kiangah hong kigen bang lianin piang ding ci-in Pasian ka um hi.
Ahi zongin tuikulh khatpeuh' gei-a tui daina mun i tot phot bel kul ding hi,” ci hi.
Zan a sawmlelina hita a, zankim hun Adriatic Tuipi tungah ka kikawihei laitakun tuinawl leigam khat a naih ta hidingin tembaw nasemte in ummawh uh hi.
Tua hangin siklum khaukhih tawh tui thukna teh uh a, pi zakhat-sawmnih kiim thuk hi. A den deuh ciangin tehkik uh a, pi sawmkua thuk hi.
Tuinawl suangpite lakah ka awk ding uh a lau manun amaute in tembaw tawlam pan sikkawikip li khiasuk uh a, khuavak ding kal ngakin om uh hi.
Tembaw nasemte tembaw pan taikhiat sawm uh a, tembaw lulam pan sikkawikipte a khia ding kineihin gunkuang a khaisuk laitakun
Paul in za-uk bupa leh galkapte' kiangah, “Hih mite tembaw tungah a om lohin na suakta zo kei ding uh hi,” ci hi.
Tua ciangin galkapte in gunkuang khauhualte sattat uh a, gunkuang kia khahkhia uh hi.
Khuavak kuan ciangin Paul in amaute a vekun an a nek nadingun hanthawn a, “Tuni pen note anletui lo tawh na om uh, lungsim kinga theilo-in bangmah na nek loh uh, ni sawmleli a cinna hita hi.
Tua ahih manin an na nek ding uh kong hanthawn hi. A hang pen tua in hong nungtasak ding a, na lu tung uh-a samzang khat nangawn bangmah ci lo ding hi,” ci hi.
Hih thute a gen khit ciangin Paul in anlum la a, vekpi' mai-ah Pasian' hehpihna a phat khit ciangin balnenin ne hi.
Tua ciangin tua mite zong lungsim thadim uh a, an ne ciat uh hi.
(Tembaw tungah ka vekun mihing zanih sawmsagih-le-guk ka pha uh hi.)
An gilvahin a nek khit uh ciangin mangbuhte tuipi sungah lawnkhia-in tembaw zangsak uh hi.
Tu-in khuavak ta a, koi mun koi gam cih a theih loh uh hangin tuinawl piau a nei tuidawk khat a muh uh ciangin a pian theih leh tua takah tembaw khawlsak dingin geel uh hi.

Tua hangin sikkawikipte khiasukin tuipi sungah nusia uh a, tua kawmin khauhual tawh kikam tembaw heina singpekpite zong sutkhia uh hi. Tua ciangin huihkhawm puanthaan nuainung khaito-in tuinawl piau lam manawh uh hi.
Ahih hangin tembaw in tuiluang nih kipaipelh mun phu kha-in tui daina mun tawnkha hi. Tembaw a lulam awk pahin taang thei nawnlo a, a tawlam zong tuihual in satkham hi.
Tu-in galkapte in thongkiate tuipekin a taimang ding uh deihlohna tawh thah ding geel uh hi.
Ahih hangin za-uk bupa in Paul suaktasak nuam ahih manin galkapte' geelna kham a, tuipek theite tembaw pan diangkhia masa-in leilak a va zuat nadingun, leh
a omlai teng in singpek leh tembaw van themnengte a let kawm nadingun thupia hi. Tu-a bang danin mite a vekun cidamin leilak kitunpih hi.Malta Tuikulh Gam
